# DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 32G64G GGUF — moved

The GGUF files are not in this repository. They are in
**[zephel01/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-IQ2_XXS-32G64G-GGUF](https://huggingface.co/zephel01/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-IQ2_XXS-32G64G-GGUF)**
(folder `L72`, for a 32 GB GPU + 64 GB RAM), with the model card, the speeds and the checks.
